Market today: Mixed signals are at play. While some tech names might show resilience, the underlying current points to a 'Big Tech spending squeeze' and 'AI debt worries.' The Fed's ongoing efforts to slow the economy also suggest headwinds for growth-oriented tech and chip names.

Your holdings: Your leveraged ETFs are a major concern, especially SOXL (-85.49%) and MUU (-72.09%). These products decay and are amplified by margin, making drawdowns extra painful. SMH (-32.94%) and SMCI (-48.45%) are also deep in the red and need attention. Remember, margin amplifies drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any further news regarding Big Tech spending and AI debt. Also, critically review and adjust your stops on leveraged positions, as many are currently very far from current prices.

Bottom line: Your heavy concentration in leveraged tech on margin demands aggressive risk management, especially with current macro headwinds.
plays: Trim SOXL: Your -85.49% loss on this 3X leveraged ETF is extreme. Consider cutting losses to preserve capital, especially with its default stop at 200 far from 32.6.
Review MUU: At -72.09% and a stop at 31.6 vs. 10.38 price, this 2X leveraged ETF also needs immediate attention to manage downside risk.
Consider SPXS: With SPY/QQQ in 'SELL' status and macro headwinds, a small hedge could be prudent. Scanner entry 28.73-28.7, stop 28.5.
